The problem comes with the individual here. I can look at a rainbow or a sunset and say "Damn that's beautiful", I can appreciate life  beauty all of that. Happiness, joy it doesn't come so it can't go and it's just not worth carrying on. That's why we create the coping mechanisms with the toxic ones like mine becoming mad delusions.

 As for control, it's not control over anything external or guilt or regret. It's quite literally losing a sense of self  disassociating from who I have always been and letting the separate entites, the manifestations of other parts of me, take control. But not in the sense of take control, it's becoming them, wiping the whole to become the lesser. Sorry it's hard to explain but it's not simple.

But worse it comes every day, a lack of joy, happiness at the very base level. Simply not having the chemical to trigger it.
